ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.70:0.30 ratio of low-intensity (black/dark grey) to high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous low-intensity dark region concentrated centrally. High-intensity white regions located at the distal tips of both lobes. Left lobe distal tip features isolated dark circular spots. Right lobe distal tip exhibits dense dark mottling and speckling.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central notch with an estimated interior angle of 45 degrees relative to the vertical axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge boundary. Significant jagged amplitude peaks observed at the lateral-most margins of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Broadly convex outer margins that curve inward towards a sharp, deep central notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Visible clusters of high-contrast dark circular spots on the white-pigmented areas of the distal lobe tips, most prominent on the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple distinct white linear streaks (rake marks) crossing the dark central pigmentation, primarily oriented diagonally from upper-left to lower-right.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear rake marks across the central fluke body; highly ragged and tattered distal margins indicating prior tissue loss or damage.
other_distinctive_markers: One prominent dark circular spot located in the upper section of the white pigmentation on the left lobe tip.
